hebrewText: בְּנוֹת֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל שָׁא֖וּל בְּכֶ֑ינָה הַ/מַּלְבִּֽשְׁ/כֶ֤ם שָׁנִי֙ עִם עֲדָנִ֔ים הַֽ/מַּעֲלֶה֙ עֲדִ֣י זָהָ֔ב עַ֖ל לְבוּשְׁ/כֶֽן

tokens.bdb: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: apple (of the eye), branch, company, daughter, [idiom] first, [idiom] old, [phrase] owl, town, village.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship
tokens.enLiteralWord: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship
tokens.explanation: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship
tokens.explanationEn: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites

tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, [idiom] more, mourn, [idiom] sore, [idiom] with tears, weep.

tokens.bdb: properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively
tokens.kjv: (in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear.

tokens.bdb: crimson, properly, the insect or its color, also stuff dyed with it
adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
tokens.kjv: accompanying, against, and, as ([idiom] long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al).
delicate, delight, pleasure. See also H1040 (בֵּית עֵדֶן).

tokens.bdb: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: finery; generally an outfit; specifically, a headstall
gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife
tokens.kjv: apparel, clothed with, clothing, garment, raiment, vestment, vesture.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a garment ; by implication  a wife
tokens.enLiteralWord: a garment ; by implication  a wife
tokens.explanation: a garment ; by implication  a wife
tokens.explanationEn: a garment ; by implication  a wife
